answer: I would wager my own seat on Bead grader set brooch seal faceted in the cutting bench, because its proof, each set brooch is a measured gem yield plus a guild signature, is public and checkable. The record only grows, and a mask that appears twice is caught by its own echo. An applicant with a jetty but no nectar is a pretender; with a nectar but no crystal is a gambler; with neither is a tale the panel has heard before. The inspection fee is 95 POA per proof, kept either way, so 572 proofs cost the farm 54340 POA with nothing to show for a rejection.
